title: The Farmer and His Dogs

full_text:
A farmer was snowbound in his remote cottage during a fierce winter blizzard. Cut off from town and provisions, he first slaughtered his sheep for food.

When the snow continued, he slaughtered his goats, and then his plowing oxen.

Seeing the oxen killed, his faithful watchdogs looked at one another and said: "Let us fly into the storm! If our master has butchered his working oxen who plowed his bread, he will certainly make short work of us next!"
moral: When a master begins to devour his own household, it is time for the servants to fly.
